items.difficulty_reason: The proof factors f through its scheme-theoretic image Z, applies the delivered birational surjection-on-Pic lemma to X -> Z (isomorphism over the dense open V  cap  Z) and the delivered lift-from-reduction lemma to Z -> Y, and closes with 'Some details omitted'. The two cited mechanisms are delivered; the omitted closing is the final assembly of the two surjectivities and the interaction of the hypotheses. H2 with spotcheck: the components are delivered and correctly invoked, but the assembly step the author left out is where a reader could stumble.
